$comment: Committed copy of the SDK's human-readable reason vocabulary (stellar-agent-guard-sdk: src/reasons.ts explainReason). The SDK repo asserts ITS copy against THIS file (companion SDK issue: parity gate on the sdk side). tests/reason_parity.rs keeps this file in lockstep with Error::reason() in src/types.rs, and scripts/check-reason-parity.sh re-checks it standalone (CI, after tests). Add a reason here and in src/types.rs in the same PR — this file failing is the deliberate friction that forces both sides to move together.

source.sdk_side_gate: see docs/issues/sdk-reason-parity-gate.md — the SDK repo asserts its shipped map against this file (companion issue text; file in the SDK tracker)

reasons.unauthorized: Signature verification failed or the caller lacks authority for this action.
reasons.already_initialized: initialize was called on an account that is already initialized.
reasons.not_initialized: The account has no registered agent key yet; all authorizations are default-denied.
reasons.invalid_config: set_policy was given a config that fails validation; the previous policy is unchanged.
reasons.invalid_amount: The transfer amount is zero or negative.
reasons.admin_frozen: The policy admin has frozen the account; nothing moves until unfreeze.
reasons.heartbeat_expired: The dead-man switch fired: the agent has been silent longer than the grace period.
reasons.no_policy: No policy is installed (revoked or never set); the account is default-deny.
reasons.paused: The installed policy's kill switch is set.
reasons.outside_active_window: The current time is outside the policy's active_from/active_until window.
reasons.asset_not_allowed: The SAC token contract being called is not in the policy's assets allowlist.
reasons.recipient_not_allowed: The recipient is not in the policy's recipients allowlist.
reasons.recipient_blocked: The recipient is on the policy's explicit denylist; the denylist wins over the allowlist and any escape hatch.
reasons.per_tx_cap_exceeded: The transfer amount exceeds the per-transaction cap.
reasons.window_cap_exceeded: The transfer would exceed the rolling-window spend cap.
reasons.protocol_not_allowed: The contract being called is not in the policy's protocols allowlist.
reasons.function_not_allowed: The function is not in the protocol rule's function allowlist (or is a non-transfer function on an asset).
reasons.unknown_contract: The contract (or call shape) is not recognized; the account is default-deny about what it cannot reason about.
reasons.self_function_not_allowed: A self-call to a function other than heartbeat.
reasons.create_contract_not_allowed: Contract creation authorized by the account is denied in v1.
reasons.protocol_call_rate_exceeded: The rolling-window protocol call rate limit would be exceeded.
